display_name: 粗恢复与独立学生源域互补诊断
description: 比较 DURA 粗恢复、独立宽源学生和完整 DURA 的源 IQ 误差及不可部署的逐条理想凸组合。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 CPU two threads, CUDA disabled, nice 10

data.representation: 672 fixed source pilot paired received/clean IQ, frozen DURA output
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 previously explored source pilot IDs disjoint from 32768 prior fit IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored 672 source pilot; not an independent blind test
data.leo_config_ref: Source fixed epoch19 seven simulated views

permissions.claim_scope: Source IQ complementarity only; per-record clean oracle is nondeployable, not identity accuracy or general bound

checkpoint.initialization: Fixed final source-only wide direct student and fixed DURA; no model updates
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Wide student fixed commit and 32768 fit IDs, source pilot disjoint; fixed DURA checkpoint and data permissions
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Both checkpoints source-only with no F/TX/V/target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: One fixed wide student and original DURA, no target-based selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only 2 threads, nice 10, preserve all existing owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, nonfinite output or loss, target/F/TX access or technical failure; do not change other jobs

expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 source groups, three pairs and clean-oracle convex mixtures

metric_names: source IQ NMSE of fixed endpoints
source clean oracle convex-mixture IQ NMSE
dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8 x seven source views x 48
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Fixed source DURA coarse, wide student and DURA plus privileged optimal convex mixing
rows.purpose: Determine source IQ complementarity before proposing an independent or hybrid recovery architecture
rows.seed_notes: Previously fixed source-only students and DURA; no training or new random selection
rows.scenario: fixed previously explored source pilot grouped by RX and source simulation view
rows.budget_ref: 672 source pilot records x three fixed pair comparisons; source clean only as analysis oracle
expected_artifacts: result.json: 14 source groups, three pairs and clean-oracle convex mixtures

notes: Source pilot already explored and may have been seen by DURA; student fit excludes pilot.
Per-record ideal mixture weight depends on source clean and is unavailable for deployment.
No F weights, TX labels, V or target data; wave NMSE is not TX identity accuracy.
First batch compares actual two-stage DURA to the real checkpoint forward as a no-query smoke.
